paragraphs.text: We fine-tune BERT on SST-2 and report accuracy of 0.91 in our classification experiments.
The transformer encoder is trained with a contrastive learning objective on Wikitext.
Devlin et al. reported that BERT outperforms the CNN baseline on SST-2 by 2.1 accuracy points.
Our annotated corpus contains 12 000 abstracts from computational linguistics.
We find that attention accounts for most of the gain on SST-2 classification.
